verdict.rationale: a-Shell offers only indirect event-driven automation. It runs `.profile` automatically whenever a new window opens, which can set environment variables or clean up files. It is also compatible with Apple Shortcuts, so complex Shortcuts can drive a-Shell commands, but the evidence never shows a native rule engine or general event triggers. Missing for 10: a native rules/trigger system, documented event types beyond window open (e.g. file changes, schedules), evidence that Shortcuts automations can trigger a-Shell on events, and hands-on corroboration.
